title: telemetry-guided pretriage sanity-checker and lightweight oncall hook
author: Maya Singh
release_notes: Add a lightweight telemetry-guided sanity checker and a pretriage CLI hook to reduce oncall noise; opt-in by default for slo-toolkit deployments; includes docs and telemetry metrics for tuning.
description: Motivation: on-call teams spend time investigating noisy alerts that are detectable as instrumentation anomalies (missing series, stale exporters, or thin traffic windows) before starting a full incident triage. This PR adds a lightweight 'pretriage sanity checker' that runs a small set of telemetry probes when an alert is received and surfaces a short human-readable verdict and artifacts to the responder. Design summary: implement a probe runner (timeout-first, non-blocking) that evaluates a configurable probe set against Prometheus and tracing backends, computes a compact fingerprint, and emits a JSON snapshot + human summary. Ship a CLI hook and a webhook payload for incident-bot/slo-toolkit to call as part of pretriage. Safety and opt-in: default checks are safe read-only Prometheus queries and a trace existence probe; probes and timeouts are configurable per-team via runtime config. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to 10% of responses for two weeks, converge on rule tweaks, then enable org-wide. Checklist: 1) implement probe runner and schema; 2) add incident-bot hook + webhook contract; 3) surface results in oncall brief (summary line + artifact link); 4) add docs and runbook snippets; 5) add metrics and dashboard for false-positive rate. Testing: unit tests for probe parsing and mock Prom queries; integration test that exercises the webhook path using a local Prometheus test server; end-to-end smoke in canary environment. Related work: builds on prior compact-snapshot work and the 'telemetry-sanity-prober' spike (ENG-1982) and coordinates with incident-bot runbook suggestions. Backwards compatibility: webhook payloads are additive; incident-bot falls back if pretriage fails or times out. Implementation notes: the probe runner uses a 1.5s per-probe soft timeout and an overall 5s hard timeout; queries are sampled at scrubbed time windows for PII safety. Observability: new metrics prefixed slo.pretriage.* (attempts, timeouts, probe_failures, judgments) and a dashboard template in docs/dashboards/pretriage.md. Migration steps: operators can toggle feature via SLO_TOOLKIT_PRETRIAGE_ENABLED and tune PROBE_SET_PATH. Security: no credentials stored; Prometheus read-only credentials documented. This PR description is a compact summary of the commits, files changed, review thread, and CI outcome.

Maya Singh: Added histogram metric and verified non-blocking behavior; moved network calls into bounded goroutine pool; updated docs to recommend 5s only for low-volume routes.
Ethan Park: Minor nit on schema.md examples (use UTC timestamps), otherwise LGTM after CI passes.
Jonas Becker: Could we add an opt-out annotation for legacy services? Suggest adding SERVICE_PRETRIAGE=false support; I left a small patch in runner.go.

merge_commit_message: slo-toolkit: telemetry-guided pretriage sanity checker (adds probe runner, webhook, docs, metrics)
post_merge_actions: Deployed to canary namespace, feature flag enabled for 10% of alert webhooks. Dashboards created under org SLO -> Pretriage. Notified oncall and SE teams in #oncall-tooling.
ci_summary: All checks passed: unit (ok), integration (ok), lint (ok). One flaky e2e rerun required; reran and green. Coverage delta +0.8%.
notes_for_ops: Default probe set lives at /etc/slo-toolkit/pretriage/default_probes.yaml. To disable pretriage for a service, set SERVICE_PRETRIAGE=false in service annotations or toggle SLO_TOOLKIT_PRETRIAGE_ENABLED=false in deployment config.
examples_and_docs: docs/runbooks/pretriage-guide.md includes example webhook payloads and sample queries. The CLI 'slo-pretriage' supports --local-run to reproduce pretriage output locally.
testing_matrix: unit: go test ./...; integration: mocked Prom server (local CI); e2e: canary namespace run using incident-bot webhook emulator. Observability smoke verifies slo.pretriage.attempts > 0 after canary deployment.
estimated_impact: Expected to reduce mean triage time for noisy alerts by ~30% in the canary group; will monitor false-positive suppression rate and adjust probe thresholds.
author_acknowledgement: I confirm credentials are not stored and queries are scrubbed; ownership transferred to oncall-tooling for maintenance after merge.
